query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_leads,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phone = '' AND email = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as both_empty,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phone = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as phone_empty,
  SUM(CASE WHEN email = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as email_empty,
  SUM(CASE WHEN phone != '' OR email != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_some_contact
FROM leads;
